rationale: All findings resolved. CR-001 (wiki and work-item processors passing Optional[str] project to str-typed loader constructors, producing 'None' in ADO REST URLs) was fixed by adding MissingIntegrationException guards in _init_loader for both processors. Check round (code-review-check.json) confirmed resolution. All three lenses ran; acceptance lens shows AC-1/2/3/4/6 pass, AC-5 partial (RequiredField lazy-validation for organization is project-standard behavior), AC-7 partial (test_settings_service.py unrunnable due to pre-existing tree_sitter_languages incompatibility — confirmed pre-existing before this change). 19/19 new tests pass, ruff clean.

findings.problem: Both datasource processors pass self.credentials.project (now Optional[str]) to AzureDevOpsWikiLoader and AzureDevOpsWorkItemLoader constructors, which both declare project: str (non-optional). The loaders embed self.project in every URL construction (e.g. f'{self.base_url}/{self.project}/_apis') and all SDK calls. When project=None, the URL contains literal '/None/' and SDK calls receive None for a str parameter.
findings.resolution: Added 'if not self.credentials.project: raise MissingIntegrationException(...)' guard at the top of _init_loader in both processors. Committed in EPMCDME-10926: Guard against None project in ADO wiki and work-item processors.

business_review.criterion: Reorder AzureDevOpsCredentials fields: base_url first, then organization, then project, then access_token
business_review.notes: Declaration order in settings.py confirmed: base_url, organization, project, access_token. test_field_order asserts it.

business_review.criterion: Make base_url, organization, and access_token mandatory (reject blank/missing with 422)
business_review.notes: Field(min_length=1) on all three fields. Parametrized tests confirm empty-string and missing-field rejections raise ValidationError.

business_review.criterion: Keep project optional (absent or null accepted without error)
business_review.notes: Optional[str] = None. test_valid_without_project and test_project_none_explicit confirm both None and absent project accepted.

business_review.criterion: Reorder GenericAzureDevOpsConfig fields: url, organization, project, token
business_review.notes: Declaration order in models.py confirmed: url, organization, project, token. test_field_order asserts it (excluding credential_type).

business_review.criterion: GenericAzureDevOpsConfig rejects instantiation with missing organization
business_review.notes: RequiredField uses lazy-validation: default='' with json_schema_extra['required_at_runtime']=True. No constructor-time ValidationError; instantiation with no organization succeeds (organization=''). This is the project's established pattern for UI-facing credential configs. Test correctly validates the metadata rather than a ValidationError. AC partially met via metadata, not Pydantic strict enforcement.

business_review.criterion: get_azure_devops_creds() returns project=None when stored value is empty string
business_review.notes: project or None coercion in the service layer return statement. New test confirms this behavior.

business_review.criterion: Existing tests pass; new tests cover mandatory-field rejection and optional project
business_review.notes: 19/19 new tests pass across test_azure_devops_credentials.py (10 tests) and test_models.py (9 tests). test_settings_service.py is unrunnable due to pre-existing tree_sitter_languages incompatibility with Python 3.13 — confirmed pre-existing before this change by stashing changes and re-running. New test in that file is correct but untestable in this environment.

standards_review.notes: All commits use 'EPMCDME-10926: <description>' format matching the project convention.
ruff format, ruff check --fix, and ruff check all pass on changed files. No new linting issues introduced.
No secrets, no injection surfaces, no auth bypass. access_token remains a plain str with min_length=1 (no logging exposure introduced). sensitive marker on GenericAzureDevOpsConfig.token preserved.
